topic: Risk-of-bias appraisal of studies on NLRP3 inhibition in septic acute kidney injury

studies.title: NLRP3 inhibition in septic acute kidney injury: a randomised controlled trial
studies.abstract: We randomised 180 patients with septic acute kidney injury to an NLRP3 inhibitor or placebo and measured renal recovery at 28 days.

sections.methods: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. A computer-generated random sequence with allocation concealment was used. Outcome assessors were blinded. The trial was pre-registered and all pre-specified outcomes are reported. Complete outcome data were available.
sections.results: NLRP3 inhibition reduced the composite renal outcome; adverse events were similar between groups.

studies.title: Urinary NLRP3 and renal recovery in septic acute kidney injury: a prospective cohort study
studies.abstract: In 96 patients with sepsis we measured urinary NLRP3 at admission and followed renal recovery for 90 days.

sections.methods: Prospective single-centre cohort. Urinary NLRP3 was measured with a standardised assay. Analyses were adjusted for confounders including age, SOFA score and baseline creatinine. Some missing data were handled by multiple imputation. Outcome assessment was not blinded.
sections.results: Higher urinary NLRP3 was associated with slower renal recovery.
